create.name: Elizabeth B. Jenkins
create.bio:
Elizabeth B. Jenkins is an American author and teacher of the Inka Nature Wisdom tradition held by the Q'ero people of the Peruvian Andes. A spiritual experience in Peru in 1989 set the direction of her life; she went on to study the Andean path, including with the anthropologist Juan Núñez del Prado, while working for twenty years as a licensed marriage and family therapist. She began guiding individuals and small groups in 1992 and, after her book The Return of the Inka (first published as Initiation) appeared in 1997, taught widely in Europe and beyond.

She founded the Wiraqocha Foundation, now Nature Wisdom House, in 1996 to support the Q'ero and share their lineage, and in 2021 co-founded the Global Paqo School, an online programme in which Q'ero elders teach students directly through translation. Her teaching centres on reciprocity with nature: invocations and offerings to the nature beings, the Andean energy body and the move from fear towards personal responsibility. She also leads expeditions to Peru and teaches on The Shift Network. Her other books are Journey to Q'eros and The Fourth Level. She lives on an organic farm on Hawai'i Island.

books.title: The Return of the Inka: A Journey of Initiation & Inka Prophecies for 2012
books.author: Elizabeth B. Jenkins
books.description: Elizabeth Jenkins' account of her initiation into the Andean mystical tradition after a life-changing experience in Peru, first published as Initiation in 1997. It introduces the Inka prophecies and the practices of exchanging energy with nature.

books.title: The Fourth Level: Nature Wisdom Teachings of the Inka
books.author: Elizabeth B. Jenkins
books.description: A practical guide to the Inka Nature Wisdom tradition, drawing on three decades of study with Andean teachers. It sets out the Andean energy body, the nature beings and the practices for moving into what the tradition calls the fourth level of consciousness.

courses.title: Inka Nature Wisdom of the Q'ero
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course on The Shift Network introducing Q'ero nature practices. Students learn to find their nature mother and father, make invocations and offerings, work with the Andean 'seven eyes' energy system and build a mandala of local nature beings.

courses.title: Global Paqo School 2027
courses.description: A year-long online training, part of a four-year programme, in which teams of Q'ero elders teach the four core Andean protocols of invocation, receiving, requesting and offering through live weekly Zoom classes with translation. Students also work in small mentored groups; Elizabeth Jenkins directs and facilitates the school.

courses.title: Gold & Silver Wisdom of the Inkas: Peru Expedition
courses.description: A twelve-day expedition to the Peruvian Andes focused on the sacred feminine and masculine wisdom of the Inka tradition, organised by Nature Wisdom House. It continues a programme of journeys to Peru that Elizabeth Jenkins and the foundation have run since 1992.
courses.price: $4,650 USD (double room); $4,250 USD early bird with deposit by 31 December 2026

free_resources.title: World Healing Under the Full Moon
free_resources.description: A free monthly online gathering at each full moon in which Global Paqo students and friends join Q'ero practices to send light to places of conflict and suffering. The page gives the invitation, instructions and joining link for the next date.
